cues.text: On a golden savannah, tall dry grass rustles around dark, rugged boulders.
Resting on a rock, a creature with a sleek feline body, a long thin tail, and a spiked head looks across the plains.
High above strange trees with thick, bulbous trunks and bare branches, a bright white landing craft streaks down through the pale blue sky.

beats.note: A dry, golden savannah landscape with swaying grass and rocky outcrops.
A creature with a feline body, a long tail, and a spiked head rests on a boulder in the foreground.
In the background, strange trees with thick, bulbous trunks and bare branches stand under a blue sky.
A bright white streak, a landing craft, cuts diagonally down through the sky.
The streak fades as the craft descends out of sight.
